Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
I just had a menagerie of questions about some various cards and particular
solutions. I would greatly appreciate it if someone could answer them. Thanks!

#1. For vampires with + stealth (Jost, Muaziz, and Rebecca), is this only
applied at the beginning or continuous? If Jost bleeds at +1 stealth and then
someone plays a Veiled Sight does he go to +0 stealth or does his ability up it
back to +1?

#2. In the new Rulebook, it says (pg. 53) "Additionally, clan justicar titles
can only be given to a vampire of the appropriate clan." So does that vampire
have to continue to be that clan to retain the title (I thought previous
rulings were that you had to remain the clan). So if Anneke Clan Impersonates
to clan Ventrue, is she still a Justicar? In addition, is she considered
"Toreador Justicar" or just "Justicar?" Just double-checking.

#3. Just to double-check (again), all the Camarilla titles ('cept maybe
Justicar) are based on Sect allegiance, not clan, right? If Arika with a Writ
of Acceptance is Deranged (she is now !Malk but Camarilla), she still has her 4
votes, right?

#4. For superior Blessing of Chaos, when it says actions requiring those
disciplines does this apply to the first time they're played or not? For
example, you clearly can't initially play a Derange card on a Blessed vampire
since it requires Dementation. But how about later when you use the Derange
card's text to move it? You don't need to have Dementation to perform this
action. But Derange is still a Dementation card. So?

#5. I know that for cards that "can be played once per game," if it is Sudden
Reversed or Direct Interventioned, it counts as being played. How about if it
is blocked? Or a vote is Delaying Tactics'ed? (How do you like my creation of
new verbs?)

#6. What happens if you use Vast Wealth but don't find any equipment. Nothing I
suppose? And can you use Vast Wealth if you KNOW you have no equipment left?
Like if you just want to reshuffle.

#7. Is Shadow Strike ("Strength ranged damage, with an optional maneuver ")
considered a "Strike" (for purposes of Thoughts Betrayed for example)?

Thanks!

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
halc...@aol.com (Halcyan 2) wrote:
> #1. For vampires with + stealth (Jost, Muaziz, and Rebecca), is this
> only applied at the beginning or continuous? If Jost bleeds at +1
> stealth and then someone plays a Veiled Sight does he go to +0
> stealth or does his ability up it back to +1?

It goes to zero.

> #2. In the new Rulebook, it says (pg. 53) "Additionally, clan
> justicar titles can only be given to a vampire of the appropriate
> clan." So does that vampire have to continue to be that clan to
> retain the title (I thought previous rulings were that you had to
> remain the clan). So if Anneke Clan Impersonates to clan Ventrue,
> is she still a Justicar? In addition, is she considered
> "Toreador Justicar" or just "Justicar?" Just double-checking.

The rulebook addresses this as well, on page 52: "If a vampire
with a title changes clans or sects to a clan or sect
inappropriate for his title, he loses the benefit of the title."

So Anneke loses the benefit of the "Toreador Justicar" title for
as long as she is not Toreador.

> #3. Just to double-check (again), all the Camarilla titles ('cept
> maybe Justicar) are based on Sect allegiance, not clan, right? If
> Arika with a Writ of Acceptance is Deranged (she is now !Malk but
> Camarilla), she still has her 4 votes, right?

Right. (Clan Justicar is clan-based as well as sect-based.)

> #4. For superior Blessing of Chaos, when it says actions requiring
> those disciplines does this apply to the first time they're played
> or not?
> For example, you clearly can't initially play a Derange card on a
> Blessed vampire since it requires Dementation. But how about later
> when you use the Derange card's text to move it? You don't need to
> have Dementation to perform this action. But Derange is still a
> Dementation card. So?

The action to move derange doesn't require Demenation (otherwise
most victims would be unable to move it). So it is free to target
a Blessed vampire.

> #5. I know that for cards that "can be played once per game," if
> it is Sudden Reversed or Direct Interventioned, it counts as being
> played. How about if it is blocked? Or a vote is Delaying
> Tactics'ed? (How do you like my creation of new verbs?)

If the card is played, it is played.
If it can only be played once per game, it cannot be played again.

> #6. What happens if you use Vast Wealth but don't find any
> equipment. Nothing I suppose? And can you use Vast Wealth if you

Nothing.

> KNOW you have no equipment left? Like if you just want to
> reshuffle.

Yes.

> #7. Is Shadow Strike ("Strength ranged damage, with an optional
> maneuver ") considered a "Strike" (for purposes of Thoughts
> Betrayed for example)?

Card text: "Strike: strength ranged damage..."
